lines.text: Many learners say: She gave me many informations.
Better: She gave me a lot of information.

data.right: She gave me a lot of information.

native.tip: information은 셀 수 없어서 s를 안 붙여요. “a lot of information”!
native.caption: “She gave me many informations”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 information은 셀 수 없는 명사라서 many나 s를 쓰지 않아요. “She gave me a lot of information”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Information cannot be counted, so no s. Say “a lot of information”.
en.caption: Do you say “She gave me many informations”? 😅 Information is uncountable, so you do not use “many” or an s. “She gave me a lot of information” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
